title: Impl: pkt_id counter and assignment in Rust
description: Add AtomicU32 pkt_id counter. For lichen-gateway: assign in ingest_mesh_frame() for RX, in push_tx_queue() for TX. Add pkt_id to frame processing context. For lichen-node: assign in runtime_receive(). File: rust/lichen-gateway/src/lib.rs or bin/lichend.rs, rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/runtime.rs. Verify: cd rust && cargo test -p lichen-gateway -p lichen-node
